about: Named exceptions to a dungeon's range and floor in the Codex (rust/crates/forge-data/src/codex/journal.rs, levels_of). By the rule a dungeon's range is the client's Group Finder's (GroupFinderActivity: MinLevel to MaxLevelSuggestion, never under the client's own minimum) and its floor, the level the guides' dungeon steps and the hub's "For your level" start at, is that bottom or players' recorded 25th percentile entry level (data/codex/recorded.json, dungeons; 5 people with a boss kill or more), whichever is higher. A row here overrides a top (max) or a floor (floor), cited the way forever-db/corrections cites a fact (source: { kind, ref }) with a note saying why. A row with overleveledRuns: true changes neither: it only stops the build's check of players' 90th percentile entry level against the top, for a dungeon players run well above its range (recorded_check). Keep it to the exceptions the maintainer approved: journal.rs's tests list them.

source.ref: Fitz, 2026-11-13: the game shows The Hall of Thanes as levels 13-18

levels.note: The client's Group Finder suggests it up to level 20; players' recordings agree with 18 (42 people with a boss kill, 90th percentile entry level 17.8).

source.ref: Fitz, 2026-11-13: floor 43 for Krol'dok Stronghold only

levels.note: By the rule its floor is players' 25th percentile entry level, 43.5 (9 people with a boss kill). Its only slot in the guides, the end of the Riverglades guides' part 4, sits right at that level, where about half the players stand under it; 43 is inside its 40-47 and it is run with a full party of five.

source.ref: players' recordings to 2026-11-17: 109 characters with a boss kill in the Ruins of Lordaeron

levels.note: Players run it well above its range: their 90th percentile entry level is 30.4 (83 people with a boss kill) against the Group Finder's top of 22. The 16 characters who entered at level 25 or higher ran it: 15 full clears of all six bosses, every kill in a party of five, 48 minutes to 7 hours inside. The range (15-22) and the floor stay as the rule makes them.

source.ref: players' recordings to 2026-11-20: 148 characters with a boss kill in Wailing Caverns

levels.note: Players run it well above its range: their 90th percentile entry level is 34 (120 people with a boss kill) against the Group Finder's top of 24; to 17 November it was 31.3, inside the check. The 16 characters who entered at level 30 or higher (30 to 60) killed its bosses 126 times, every kill in a party of five: carries and repeat runs, not a sign the range is wrong. The range and the floor stay as the rule makes them.
